origin_scope: A paid-job interpretation is conditional on actual originating output acceptance. Otherwise originating development is research expenditure with no revenue.
customer_evidence: Primary providers offer scientific-software, modeling and experiment-design services. There are no buyer interviews, matched project quotations, measured arrival rates or customer sales in this edition.
proposal_mechanism: Matched enterprises select from the same finite researcher-authored menu using only development evidence and identical buyer hypotheses. This is executable bounded proposal selection, not autonomous open-ended invention.

offerings.beneficiary: Engineering team selecting one intervention for a costly black-box process
offerings.decision: Choose a feasible intervention that meets the fixed response target while respecting the declared query budget
offerings.deliverable: Executable local response model, selected design, exact input-feasibility checks, final independently observed target-response check, provenance and rerun instructions
offerings.acceptance: Fresh final target-response query meets y >= 2.0, plan cost <= 1.2 and exact input bounds. One final verification query is within the declared budget. Global optimality and prediction NRMSE are separately scored research metrics, not promised by this offering.
offerings.why_human_costly: Scope definition, simulator integration, iterative design, independent checking and reproducible packaging require technical work; the sixteen-hour estimate is unvalidated.
offerings.frontier_limitation_hypothesis: An unfamiliar response surface may require scarce observations even with competent coding, tools and ordinary adaptive design. No measured frontier-model limitation is asserted.
offerings.specialist: Reusable interaction-support prior that guides experiment selection and target-model fitting
offerings.reuse_scope: New coefficient values and new design missions sharing some recurring interactions; shifted and novel interactions can defeat transfer
offerings.falsifiers: Ordinary adaptive design meets the same budget and target; inherited prior provides no fresh causal gain; final verification/correction erases savings; customers do not value the constrained design task.

offerings.beneficiary: Research team requiring an executable approximation for a simulator family
offerings.decision: Use a validated response model for repeated scenario exploration
offerings.deliverable: Executable coefficient artifact, fitting/invocation code, fresh independent prediction assessment and documented domain limitations
offerings.acceptance: Prediction NRMSE satisfies the frozen technical threshold on 384 independent labeled points; their acquisition is charged to paid-job cost A in the economic scenario.
offerings.why_human_costly: Model selection, software integration and validation are specialist research-software services; twelve hours is a declared estimate, not an observed time study.
offerings.frontier_limitation_hypothesis: Limited customer observations can impede reliable generalization. Strong ordinary sparse regression remains available to every baseline.
offerings.specialist: Interaction representation learned across related productive tasks
offerings.reuse_scope: Related response families, with explicit novel-family rejection and fallback
offerings.falsifiers: Common sparse solvers already meet the acceptance target, validation dominates total cost, or the customer can cheaply call the original simulator instead.

offerings.beneficiary: Process owner investigating one changed interaction in a validated response family
offerings.decision: Identify the changed interaction for a subsequent corrective investigation
offerings.deliverable: Executable diagnosis prototype, twelve fitting probes and four held-out probes, selected fault hypothesis and uncertainty/limitations
offerings.acceptance: Correct changed interaction under protected synthetic ground truth; this is a benchmark-prototype acceptance oracle, not an established live industrial diagnosis contract.
offerings.why_human_costly: Diagnosis of altered nonlinear dependencies can require experimental design and domain investigation; no scope-matched human quote exists here.
offerings.frontier_limitation_hypothesis: A reusable representation might distinguish changes using fewer probes. This is tested on synthetic ground truth only.
offerings.specialist: Composition of a transferred response representation with researcher-authored sparse fault isolation
offerings.reuse_scope: Single-interaction changes within the declared family, not arbitrary equipment failure
offerings.falsifiers: Competent Beta or the same ordinary library is equally effective; multiple faults or distribution shift break isolation; a buyer cannot validate/use the proposed diagnosis; willingness to pay fails.
